selection_prerequisite: All hyperparameters, tie-breakers, byte/capacity/ghost/object-size semantics, cold-start/admission/eviction rules are frozen before R2-09A DEV tournament runs. DEV only for selection/tuning; EVAL never used.

byte_capacity_semantics.unit: bytes of expert cache residency, per Research2 replay/policy convention
byte_capacity_semantics.object_granularity: per-expert-per-layer cache object (or repository-equivalent replay unit), sized by trace metadata; variable expert sizes respected where trace provides them
byte_capacity_semantics.deterministic_tie_breaking: All policies must define deterministic tie-breaking (primary score/key, then last-access/LRU where specified, then stable (layer, expert_id) key ascending). Ties must not depend on hash-map iteration order.
byte_capacity_semantics.cold_start: empty resident set at replay start unless an explicitly frozen warm-start variant is preregistered separately; primary contract uses canonical cold-start semantics.
byte_capacity_semantics.admission: on miss/request, object is admitted if space available after eviction; objects required simultaneously by a step/union event must respect the same byte budget semantics used by Research2 replay.
byte_capacity_semantics.eviction: evict until admitting requested object(s) fits within M; if an object cannot fit M, follow frozen replay contract behavior and record violation.
byte_capacity_semantics.global_reference_time: For LRU/LRU-K/LFU tie-break/recency metadata, use global causal access ordinal (monotonic integer incremented per served expert-object access in replay order). Deterministic.
byte_capacity_semantics.object_size_S_ref: S_ref(trace)=median of expert_bytes values over layers in trace metadata (deterministic). If unavailable, fallback S_ref=mean available expert_bytes; if none, count-based fallback S_ref=1 with explicit logging (canonical Research2 traces provide expert bytes).

baseline_families.name: Global-LRU
baseline_families.description: Unsharded global least-recently-used eviction over byte-budgeted expert cache.

fixed.recency: last access/serving order per Research2 replay semantics
fixed.eviction: victim = resident object with least recent global causal access ordinal
fixed.admission: on miss/request, admit object; evict LRU victims until bytes fit in M
fixed.tie_break: if equal recency impossible by ordinal definition, stable (layer,expert_id) asc

baseline_families.name: LFU
baseline_families.description: Unsharded global least-frequently-used eviction; deterministic frequency ties.

fixed.frequency: cumulative causal access count (integer) per object while tracked; on first admission count=1 for the causing access
fixed.tie_break: LRU-or-stable-key (must be frozen in implementation before run)
fixed.eviction: victim = lowest frequency; tie-break 1 = least recent global access ordinal (LRU among ties); tie-break 2 = stable (layer,expert_id) asc
fixed.admission: on miss/request, admit object with causal frequency count; evict until fit

baseline_families.name: 2Q
baseline_families.description: Byte-budgeted 2Q-style admission/eviction with a probationary FIFO/A1in region, ghost/A1out history, and main LRU/Am region. Strictly causal; uses only past accesses.

hyperparameters.notes: All semantics frozen; no implementation-spec deferral.

frozen_semantics.byte_partition: M_a1in=floor(M*a1in_fraction); M_am=M-M_a1in. Both are resident byte budgets.
frozen_semantics.a1in: FIFO probationary resident queue. Access to resident A1in object: no promotion, no FIFO reorder. Eviction victim: FIFO oldest. Evicting from A1in inserts key into A1out ghost.
frozen_semantics.am: Main resident LRU. Access to resident Am object: update global recency/LRU. Eviction victim: LRU (least recent global access ordinal); tie stable (layer,expert_id) asc.
frozen_semantics.a1out_ghost: Non-resident key/history only; does not consume M. Capacity G=max(1,floor(N_ref*a1out_slots_factor)), N_ref=max(1,floor(M/S_ref)). S_ref=median expert_bytes across trace layers (deterministic; fallbacks as global byte semantics). On overflow remove oldest ghost. Stores key identity only.
frozen_semantics.on_access_resident: if in Am -> Am LRU update; if in A1in -> no change.
frozen_semantics.on_miss_key_in_a1out: ghost hit: remove key from A1out; admit object to Am; evict Am LRU victims until fit.
frozen_semantics.on_miss_key_not_in_a1out: admit object to A1in; evict A1in FIFO victims until fit; each evicted A1in key inserted into A1out (applying A1out capacity).
frozen_semantics.simultaneous_required_objects: processed in deterministic stable (layer,expert_id) order; byte accounting/eviction per replay contract.

baseline_families.name: LRU-K
baseline_families.description: Byte-budgeted LRU-K using last K causal reference times/distances; K=2 is default family member. Strictly causal.

hyperparameters.notes: Semantics frozen prospectively; finite grid unchanged.

frozen_semantics.history: maintain last K reference ordinals per tracked object. On access at ordinal t, append/update history causally; if correlated_reference_period_objects=p>0, ignore updates within p ordinals after previous recorded reference for LRU-K history (deterministic suppression window); p=0 means standard LRU-K.
frozen_semantics.eviction: victim = resident object with smallest backward K-distance (oldest Kth reference). If fewer than K references, treat missing Kth reference as -infinity/oldest sentinel so insufficient-history objects are eviction-eligible by oldest available reference; tie-break by oldest last reference, then stable (layer,expert_id) asc.
frozen_semantics.admission: on miss/request admit and record causal reference; evict until fit.
frozen_semantics.cold_start: empty resident/history or empty history tables.

baseline_families.name: Aged/Decayed Frequency
baseline_families.description: Byte-budgeted frequency-aware eviction with causal aging/decay so stale popularity fades. Strictly causal; no future information.

hyperparameters.notes: Semantics frozen prospectively; finite grid unchanged.

frozen_semantics.score: floating-point or fixed deterministic scaled score S(obj).
frozen_semantics.aging: every aging_interval_steps global causal access ordinals (deterministic schedule), apply S(obj):=S(obj)*decay_factor for all tracked resident objects before processing accesses in that interval boundary as specified by implementation (must be deterministic and identical across runs).
frozen_semantics.access: on causal access to object, after scheduled aging for current step, set/increment S(obj):=S(obj)+1.0 (admission access counts).
frozen_semantics.eviction: victim = lowest S(obj); tie-break least recent global access ordinal, then stable (layer,expert_id) asc.
frozen_semantics.admission: on miss admit with S initialized by access rule; evict until fit.

baseline_families.name: Simple Recency-Frequency Hybrid (optional, preregistered slot)
baseline_families.description: Optional simple deterministic hybrid combining causal recency rank and causal frequency/decayed frequency by a fixed formula. May be evaluated only if its exact byte-capacity semantics and formula are frozen before R2-09A; otherwise omitted without EVAL impact.

hyperparameters.notes: Disabled by default in frozen space; enabling requires contract amendment/version bump before R2-09A.

frozen_semantics.note: Disabled; no semantics active. Any enablement requires amendment with full frozen semantics before R2-09A.
